title: The Name of the Wind
author: Patrick Rothfuss
notes: Kvothe's story is gripping. The magic system is one of a kind.

title: Dune
author: Frank Herbert
notes: A masterpiece of world-building. The politics and ecology are unmatched.

title: The Way of Kings
author: Brandon Sanderson
notes: Stormlight Archive is epic. Kaladin's arc is incredible.

author: George Orwell
notes: Chilling and still relevant. Room 101 is haunting.

title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
author: Douglas Adams
notes: Hilariously absurd. Put on hold but will definitely return.

title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
author: J.K. Rowling
notes: A classic. Re-read for the nostalgia.

title: Mistborn: The Final Empire
author: Brandon Sanderson
notes: The allomancy system is brilliant. Vin is a great protagonist.

title: Project Hail Mary
author: Andy Weir
notes: Best sci-fi I've read in years. Rocky is unforgettable.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
notes: Dense but rewarding. Need to get back to this.

title: The Great Gatsby
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
notes: Short but beautifully written. The green light symbolism is iconic.
